title: Final Version Lock + Release Manifest

evidence.claim: Expanded RC CI passed Python 3.10-3.13, Windows, package smoke and release preflight before final version lock.
Version 1.0.0 release entry is finalized and dated 2026-08-08.
Canonical v1.0 release content, validation requirements, safety invariants and non-self-referential release binding policy are defined.
All unit-test, Windows-native and package-smoke jobs passed; only release-preflight failed because it still required an Unreleased changelog section after final 1.0.0 version lock.
Preflight validates that CHANGELOG contains a section matching the actual declared package version and includes the release manifest among mandatory release files.
Release metadata tests enforce that CHANGELOG contains the declared package version.
Release preflight, package smoke, Linux Python 3.10-3.13 and 179/180 Windows tests passed. The sole failure was a Windows exclusive-create race after the peer lock file had already disappeared.

ProcessFileLock recognizes only known Win32 lock-contention codes (5, 32, 33) as retryable when the lock path disappears between os.open failure and existence inspection; generic permission failures remain fail-fast.
Regression coverage verifies retry of a disappearing-lock contention race and preserves fail-fast behavior for unknown permission errors.
The complete release workflow passed on the exact Windows-race-remediated 1.0.0 runtime head.

This checkpoint records the validated runtime head in a metadata-only closure commit. The resulting metadata closure head must pass the same full workflow, after which no further repository mutation is required to determine RELEASE_READY_TECHNICAL.
No irreversible merge, tag or release action is authorized by this checkpoint.
